title: Starship Letter Quest
hook: Space is a map of objects, paths, and tools—not one floating pile.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one quiet beat after each letter cue
visualStyle: friendly 3D preschool space storybook, deep blue and violet with warm star glow, rounded spacecraft forms, clean isolated subjects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child narrating a science-first imaginary mission log
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: steady 4/4 launch pulse opening into wider orbital phrases
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written mission placement; celestial bodies, spacecraft, orbital concepts and training helpers stay distinct
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: mission cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe point/shape gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a glockenspiel star-ping plus one soft countdown tom after each target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a glockenspiel star-ping plus one soft countdown tom after each target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Starship Letter Quest a coherent outbound mission: launch from Earth, enter orbit, pass observation targets, then reach outer-solar-system ideas while spacecraft parts remain tools rather than celestial objects.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child mission log moves from ground to orbit to deep-space observation; each line answers where the target belongs: sky object, spacecraft hardware, path, or training helper.
semanticArc: finish with distant tools and training context
